# Somatic SNVs/InDels

```{r snv_indel_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

vstats_pdf <- pcg_report$content$snv_indel$vstats
snv_pdf <- pcg_report$content$snv_indel$callset$variant
oncogenic_pdf <- if ("ONCOGENICITY" %in% colnames(snv_pdf)) {
  snv_pdf |>
    dplyr::filter(
      tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(.data$ONCOGENICITY, "_", " ")) %in%
        c("oncogenic", "likely oncogenic"))
} else snv_pdf[0, , drop = FALSE]
if ("ONCOGENICITY_SCORE" %in% colnames(oncogenic_pdf)) {
  oncogenic_pdf <- oncogenic_pdf |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$ONCOGENICITY_SCORE))
}
n_oncogenic_pdf <- NROW(oncogenic_pdf)
```

## Variant statistics

```{r snv_indel_stats_kpis}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: true

stat_or_na <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "N/A" else as.character(x)
cat(pcgrr:::kpi_row_pdf(list(
  list(title = "Somatic variants (total)", value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var)),
  list(title = "SNVs", value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var_snv)),
  list(title = "InDels", value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var_indel)),
  list(title = "Protein-coding variants",
       value = stat_or_na(vstats_pdf$n_var_coding)))))
```

```{r snv_indel_stats_plots}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(vstats_pdf$n_var > 0)
#| fig-width: 3.4
#| fig-height: 1.8
#| layout-ncol: 2

varstats_plots_pdf <- pcgrr:::varstats_plots_pdf(pcg_report)
for (p in varstats_plots_pdf) print(p)
```

## Oncogenic and likely oncogenic variants

```{r oncogenic_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr n_oncogenic_pdf > 0

oncogenic_pdf |>
  utils::head(max_variants_pdf) |>
  pcgrr:::variant_table_pdf(color = report_color, variant_class = FALSE)
```

```{r oncogenic_hotspot_legend}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_oncogenic_pdf > 0
cat(pcgrr:::hotspot_legend_pdf(utils::head(oncogenic_pdf, max_variants_pdf)))
```

```{r oncogenic_capped_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_oncogenic_pdf > max_variants_pdf
cat(
  "\n*Showing ", max_variants_pdf, " of ", n_oncogenic_pdf, " oncogenic/",
  "likely oncogenic variants (highest oncogenicity score first) - the ",
  "complete list is available in the Excel output.*\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r oncogenic_none_msg}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr n_oncogenic_pdf == 0
cat(pcgrr:::no_findings_pdf(
  "No oncogenic or likely oncogenic SNVs/InDels were found in this tumor sample."))
```
